# Confirm rule across all demos: find pairs of equal norm-shape objects; recolor the farther-from-template one to template color,
# where template = comp whose color occurs in exactly one comp and has >=1 cell (unique color).
def solve(I):
    I=np.array(I); h,w=I.shape
    bg=Counter(x for x in I.flatten().tolist()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cc=comps(I,bg)
    # target color: color occurring in exactly one component
    cntc=Counter(o['col'] for o in cc)
    tgts=[o for o in cc if cntc[o['col']]==1]
    tgt=max(tgts,key=len) if tgts else None
    out=I.copy()
    groups=defaultdict(list)
    for i,o in enumerate(cc): groups[n2(o['cells'])].append(i)
    for sh,ids in groups.items():
        if len(ids)==2:
            o1,o2=cc[ids[0]],cc[ids[1]]
            d1=min(abs(a-p)+abs(b-q) for a,b in o1['cells'] for p,q in tgt['cells'])
            d2=min(abs(a-p)+abs(b-q) for a,b in o2['cells'] for p,q in tgt['cells'])
            tgtcell=tgt['col']
            for p in (o2['cells'] if d2>d1 else o1['cells']):
                out[p]=tgtcell
    return out

def solveE(I):
    I=np.array(I); bgc=Counter(int(x) for r in I.tolist() for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    C=comps(I,bgc)
    cnt=Counter(o['col'] for o in C)
    U=[o for o in C if cnt[o['col']]==1 and len(o['cells'])>1]
    tgt=max(U,key=len); tcol=tgt['col']; ts=tgt['cells']
    groups=defaultdict(list)
    for i,o in enumerate(C): groups[n2(o['cells'])].append(i)
    out=I.copy()
    best=None
    for sh,ids in groups.items():
        if len(ids)==2:
            tot=len(C[ids[0]['cells']])+len(C[ids[1]['cells']])
            if best is None or tot>best[0]: best=(tot,sh,sorted(ids))
    if best is None: return out
    _,sh,(a,b)=best
    csA,CB=C[a]['cells'],C[b]['cells']
    def dm(cs): return min(abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1]) for p in cs for q in ts)
    da,db=dm(csA),dm(CB)
    idx=b if db>da else a
    for p in C[idx]['cells']: out[p]=tcol
    return out

def f(I):
    I=np.array(I)
    bgo=Counter(int(x) for r in I.tolist() for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cc=comps(I,bgo)
    cnt=Counter(o_['col'] for o_ in cc)
    UG=[o_ for o_ in cc if cnt[o_['col']]==1 and len(o_['cells'])>1]
    tgt=max(UG,key=lambda o_:len(o_['cells'])); tcol=tgt['col']; ts=tgt['cells']
    groups=defaultdict(list)
    for i,o_ in enumerate(cc): groups[n2(o_['cells'])].append(i)
    out=I.copy(); best=None
    for sh,ids in groups.items():
        if len(ids)==2:
            a,b=sorted(ids)
            tot=len(cc[a]['cells'])+len(cc[b]['cells'])
            if best is None or tot>best[0]: best=(tot,a,b)
    if best is None: return out
    _,a,b=best
    def bc(cs):
        rs=[p[0] for p in cs]; cl=[p[1] for p in cs]
        return (min(rs)+max(rs))/2,(min(cl)+max(cl))/2
    ta=abs(bc(ts)[0]-bc(cc[a]['cells'])[0])+abs(bc(ts)[1]-bc(cc[a]['cells'])[1])
    tb=abs(bc(ts)[0]-bc(cc[b]['cells'])[0])+abs(bc(ts)[1]-bc(cc[b]['cells'])[1])
    idx=b if tb>ta else a
    for p in cc[idx]['cells']: out[p]=tcol
    return out
for n in [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8]:
